description: Open Development Cambodia (ODC) publishes the Cambodian extract of the Microsoft global building footprints, republished by Open Development Cambodia; the page says the source holds 776,712,641 footprint polygons detected in imagery from 2014 to 2021 (Maxar and Airbus), gives 3,874,425 buildings for Cambodia and links a download of the country file. Coverage: the whole of Cambodia; the source release is dated 2022-05-02 and the portal record was last modified on 2022-06-01. Format and access: GeoJSON, JPEG, downloadable without registration from the Open Development Cambodia data hub (OD Mekong Datahub); the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike; cost: free. Caveats: footprints are detected by a neural network and the page quotes region-level precision and recall for the source (South Asia 94.8 percent precision, 76.7 percent recall), not a Cambodia-specific figure; the portal lists Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike, whereas the page text says the Microsoft data are under the Open Data Commons Open Database License; the GeoJSON was not opened. Simulation uses: national exposure and building-stock layers for flood, storm and heat risk models and for population and settlement modelling. Related catalogue records: Building footprints in Phnom Penh (Open Development Cambodia) (data-odc-building-footprints-in-phnom-penh); 3D-GloBFP: global three-dimensional building footprints with estimated heights (2020) (data-3d-globfp-global-3d-building-footprints); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
